name: goals_render_background_block
notes: Agreed sub-contract excludes watch_patterns inputs: C port JSON-serializes the value ('["Build done"]') while LIVE Python interpolates the raw object repr ('['Build done']') — a genuine serialization divergence worth a follow-up normalization. Also excludes >120-char command/output strings: LIVE appends an ellipsis truncation marker the C port lacks. Input grammar: '-' = empty list; entries joined by '|'; fields as key=value pairs joined by ';' (argv-safe).
